@Gideon Sato, per the channel record: you first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**. Your message said both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan, and that the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.

Nothing else in the channel describes the guard's activity before the kiosk came back. The next guard mention is at 11:03 AM, when Mateo wrote that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836. If the postmortem needs more detail on the guard's work in between, it would have to come from the guard or the dispatch office, not from this channel.
